title: Open Camping DB place record
description: One file per place at places/<last 2 characters of id, lower case>/<id>.json. No key outside this schema is allowed.

id.description: ocdb_ followed by a ULID. Assigned once, never reused.

name.description: Name from OSM, or null when the place has none.

kind.description: What the place is. The codes of schema/kinds.json: the OTWD site_types vocabulary plus the Open Camping DB extensions campground, picnic_site, farm_stay, backpacker_hostel, roofed_accommodation, reserve_campsite, long_vehicle_parking, food_and_drink, recreation_area, heritage and experience.

group.description: The kind's group, as listed in schema/kinds.json.

location.description: Node position, or the centroid of a closed way or multipolygon relation. At most 6 decimal places.

osm.description: The OSM object this record came from, or null when it is not from OSM (a contributed, feedback or community_report place, which the OSM sync never changes).

timestamp.description: When this version of the OSM object was saved: the last time anyone edited it in OSM, UTC. Left out when the OSM file the record came from had no timestamps.

facts.description: Every key is optional. Values come from OSM tags or accepted feedback.

fee.description: true when there is a charge, false when free, donation when payment is by donation (OSM fee=donation).

pets.description: Dogs: yes, leashed, no, or seasonal (allowed only in some months).

vehicle_access.description: Who may use the place, when it is restricted to some vehicles. heavy_vehicles_only: only heavy vehicles (trucks) may stop, and others can be fined. From OSM hgv=designated with motorcar=no or motor_vehicle=no, or access=no with hgv=yes or designated. More values may be added later.

pets_months.description: Only with pets seasonal: the months dogs are allowed, one OSM month range of two different months, such as May-Sep or Dec-Feb (a range may wrap the year end). A single month or a list is not allowed. From OSM dog:conditional=yes @ (May-Sep), which it converts to and from directly.

caravans.description: Caravans may stay: true, false, or offroad (only off-road caravans get in).

dump_station.description: A dump station on site (OSM sanitary_dump_station=yes/no). On a place to stay, sanitary_dump_station=customers is true too: guests may use it.

access.description: Road access: the vehicle needed to get there.

entry.description: Who may stay, from OSM access=*.

motorhomes.description: RVs and motorhomes can get in and stay (OSM motorhome=yes/no).

camper_trailers.description: Camper trailers can get in and stay.

big_rigs.description: Big rigs and buses 10 m and longer can get in and turn around.

non_drinking_water.description: Water that is not safe to drink is available.

campfires.description: Open fires allowed in fire pits (OSM openfire=yes/no).

cabins.description: Cabins or other on-site accommodation (OSM cabins=yes/no).

pub.description: A pub or hotel on site. From OSM true when an amenity=pub lies inside the place's area, never false.

swimming.description: Swimming at or next to the place.

fishing.description: Fishing at or next to the place (OSM fishing=yes/no).

walking_tracks.description: Walking tracks start at or near the place.

cycling_tracks.description: Cycling tracks at or near the place.

offroad_tracks.description: 4WD tracks at or near the place.

near_road.description: Close to a road, so road noise carries.

mobile_signal.description: Mobile signal on networks other than Telstra.

fuel.description: Fuel sold on site. From OSM true when an amenity=fuel lies inside the place's area, never false.

lpg.description: LPG gas bottle refill or swap on site. Not from OSM fuel:lpg, which is LPG at the pump (see fuels).

fuels.description: Fuels sold (OSM fuel:*=yes), in this order: diesel, unleaded_91, e10, unleaded_95, unleaded_98, e85, adblue, lpg. lpg here is LPG at the pump.

hot_water.description: Hot water in the showers or basins (OSM hot_water=yes/no, or shower=hot/cold).

toilet_type.description: How the toilets work (OSM toilets:disposal): flush, pit, chemical, or dry (composting or bucket).

operator.description: Who runs the place: a council, a parks agency, a company (OSM operator).

car_wash.description: Car or caravan wash. From OSM true when an amenity=car_wash lies inside the place's area, never false.

crocodiles.description: Crocodiles in nearby water. From OSM when the place, or a hazard within 1 km, has hazard=crocodile(s) or hazard:animal=crocodile(s).

marine_stingers.description: Box jellyfish, Irukandji or other dangerous jellyfish in nearby water, at least in season.

seasonal_closure.description: Closed for part of each year.

dangerous_when_wet.description: The way in is dangerous or closed when wet.

brand.description: The park chain or club the place belongs to (OSM brand=*).

address.description: The street address (OSM addr:*). state is an abbreviation, postcode four digits. Has a street or, for a rural address, a place.

place.description: A named rural place used instead of a street (OSM addr:place).

phone_2.description: A second phone number (the second value of OSM phone, then contact:phone).

facebook.description: The place's Facebook page, https only (OSM contact:facebook).

instagram.description: The place's Instagram page, https only (OSM contact:instagram).

tiktok.description: The place's TikTok page, https only (OSM contact:tiktok).

x.description: The place's X (Twitter) page, https only (OSM contact:twitter).

booking_url.description: Where to book, https only: from the owner, or from OSM website:booking, then reservation:website. Sync never replaces an owner's value.

booking_required.description: true when guests must book before arriving (OSM reservation=required), false when bookings are not taken (OSM reservation=no).

nearest_beach.description: The nearest OSM natural=beach within 5 km of the place's location, from the extract only. distance_m is to the nearest point of the beach (0 inside it), rounded to 10 m.

nearest_boat_ramp.description: The nearest OSM leisure=slipway within 5 km of the place's location, other than the place itself, from the extract only. distance_m is to the nearest point of the boat ramp (0 inside it), rounded to 10 m.

water_type.description: For a drinking_water_point: tank_fill (a tap for filling tanks, amenity=water_point) or fountain (amenity=drinking_water).

status.description: merged marks a tombstone: a record merged into another by a person (see merged_into).

reopens.description: Only with status temporarily_closed: the date the place reopens, YYYY-MM-DD.

description.description: Plain text from the place's verified owner, at most 500 characters, moderated like review text.

owner_verified.description: true when a person has approved the place's owner. Values with the source owner need it.

merged_into.description: Only on a tombstone (status merged): the id of the record this one was merged into. Apps that stored this id should use that one.

merged_osm.description: OSM objects of records merged into this one. The OSM sync matches them to this record and never creates them again.

part.description: true when OSM draws this object as a separate part of the same place on purpose, such as one camping area of a larger ground, rather than mapping the place twice.

rating.description: From accepted reviews, or null when there are none.

fact_sources.description: Where each value came from: osm, feedback (from apps), contributed (given directly to Open Camping DB), owner (the place's verified owner), community_report (anonymous community reports from public camping groups, imported by a person and never passed to OSM) or rule (set by the release from a documented rule in schema/fact_rules.json where no source gives a value: only in released records, never in places/, and never passed to OSM; the rule is named in fact_rules). Has exactly the keys of facts, plus optionally name, location, status and description. A missing name or location entry means OSM.

fact_dates.description: When each value that did not come from OSM was accepted, UTC: one entry for every fact_sources entry whose source is feedback, contributed, owner or community_report, and no other: a rule value has none. For community_report it is the first day of the month the report was made, not when it was imported. Left out when there are none. Values from OSM are as fresh as osm.timestamp.

fact_rules.description: Only in released records, never in places/: for each fact whose fact_sources entry is rule, the name of the rule in schema/fact_rules.json that set it, for example kind:public_toilet or national_park. Show a rule fact as what is usual for that kind of place ("Usually no dogs (national park)"), not as something anyone reported.

last_confirmed.description: When a traveller last checked the place and found it there, UTC: the time of the feedback apply run that accepted the check. Set only while the place is open. It does not move updated, so it may be later than updated. Left out when no check has confirmed the place.

standing.description: Only on a place a traveller added through an app (osm null): where it stands. shown: published, not checked yet. confirmed: travellers near it have found it there. held: waiting for a person, for example a possible duplicate. hidden: taken down after reports or by a moderator. held and hidden places are left out of the release. Left out on every other record.

moderator.description: Only on a place a traveller added (osm null): a person's decision on it, which wins over reports and checks made before it. restore puts it back, hide takes it down.

updated.description: When the record's content last changed, UTC. Adding osm.timestamp to a record that had none, or a new last_confirmed, does not move it.
